urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Pages to screenshot (up to 5,000 per run).

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: One screenshot per URL per device.

format.title: Format
format.description: Image format, or PDF of the page.

fullPage.title: Full page
fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of just the visible viewport.

selector.title: Element CSS selector
selector.description: Screenshot only this element (e.g. #pricing). Overrides full page.

hideCookieBanners.title: Hide cookie banners
hideCookieBanners.description: Hide common cookie/consent banners (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, Didomi, Quantcast, ...). Banners are hidden, never accepted.

hideSelectors.title: Extra elements to hide
hideSelectors.description: CSS selectors to hide before capturing (chat widgets, popups...).

waitUntil.title: Wait until
waitUntil.description: Navigation event to wait for before capturing.

waitForSelector.title: Wait for selector
waitForSelector.description: Wait until this CSS selector appears before capturing.

delayMs.title: Extra delay (ms)
delayMs.description: Extra wait before capturing, for animations or late content.

scrollToLoad.title: Scroll to load lazy images
scrollToLoad.description: For full-page shots, scroll through the page first so lazy-loaded images appear.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel pages
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages are captured in parallel.
